name: Blocksona
summary: Turns a selfie, a pet photo or a short description into a 64×64 Minecraft skin you can preview in 3D and download.
description: Blocksona generates 64×64 Minecraft skins from a selfie, a pet photo or a short text description, with a 3D preview and downloads for Java and Bedrock. Official pricing: 1 credit makes 1 skin; new accounts get 3 free credits valid 365 days, and failed skins are refunded. The site’s pricing page lists datePublished 2026-10-22 and dateModified 2026-11-06.

pricing.details: 3 free credits (365 days); packs from 4 € / 20 credits; Builder pass from 5 €/month.
pricing.label: Freemium
